title: MeltKV: Memory-Aligned KV Cache Compression via Variable-Bit Packed Vector Quantization for Long-Context LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on long contexts, making Key-Value (KV) caches dominate memory usage and inference latency. Existing vector quantization (VQ) methods effectively compress KV caches to sub-4-bit levels but often overlook inefficiencies in memory alignment and decoding speed. This work introduces MeltKV, a memory-latency co-optimized KV cache quantization framework for long-context LLM serving. MeltKV employs a memory-aligned variable-bit index packing scheme that adaptively assigns bit-widths to grouped key channels and compactly stores indices within standard data-types, eliminating redundant bits. Additionally, head-wise codebook sharing reduces the total codebook size while maintaining accuracy. Experiments demonstrate that MeltKV effectively compresses KV representations to sub-4-bit levels down to 1 bit and, at comparable perplexity, achieves 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency than state-o

translated_title: MeltKV：面向长上下文大语言模型的基于可变比特打包向量量化的内存对齐KV缓存压缩
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越依赖长上下文，使得键值（KV）缓存成为内存占用和推理延迟的主要瓶颈。现有的向量量化（VQ）方法虽然能将KV缓存有效压缩至4比特以下，但往往忽视了内存对齐和解码速度方面的低效问题。本工作提出了MeltKV，一个面向长上下文LLM服务、内存与延迟协同优化的KV缓存量化框架。MeltKV采用了一种内存对齐的可变比特索引打包方案，能够自适应地为分组的键通道分配比特宽度，并将索引紧凑地存储在标准数据类型中，从而消除冗余比特。此外，按注意力头共享码本的机制在保持精度的同时减小了码本的总规模。实验表明，MeltKV能将KV表示有效压缩至4比特以下乃至1比特水平，在相近困惑度下，相比现有最先进方法实现了48.1%的内存占用降低和52.9%的延迟降低。
tldr: MeltKV通过内存对齐的可变比特索引打包方案和按头码本共享机制，将长上下文LLM的KV缓存压缩至1-4比特水平，同时实现48.1%的内存降低和52.9%的延迟降低。
en_tdlr: MeltKV introduces a memory-aligned variable-bit index packing scheme with head-wise codebook sharing, compressing KV caches to sub-4-bit levels (down to 1 bit) while achieving 48.1% lower memory usage and 52.9% lower latency for long-context LLMs.
